handoff_goal: Let Gemini CLI continue frontend integration work exactly from latest Copilot state.

details: Versioned API mounted at /api/v1 with modules: auth, categories, expenses, budgets, reports.
Auth uses Firebase Admin token verification and local User/OAuthAccount sync.
Categories/Expenses/Budgets CRUD and Reports aggregates are implemented.
Shared Firebase + Axios API layer added under client/src/shared.
Sign-in and create-account flows wired to Firebase auth.
Readable auth error mapping added (no raw 'Firebase: Error (...)' shown).
Dashboard, Categories, AddExpense, Reports pages switched to backend API calls with loading/error states.

important_behavior_notes: Frontend API base URL uses VITE_API_BASE_URL with fallback http://localhost:3000/api/v1.
Axios response interceptor normalizes payloads to backend shape and redirects to '/' on 401 for protected pages.
Auth error UX now maps Firebase/backend codes to readable messages in client/src/shared/auth/errorMessages.js.
recommended_next_actions_for_gemini: Run app end-to-end: start server and client, authenticate with Firebase, verify all pages load API-backed data.
Resolve any endpoint contract mismatches found in runtime (especially PUT vs PATCH/POST route expectations).
Refine UX around create/update/delete actions on Categories and Add Expense (currently partially prompt/inline-based).
Optionally commit in logical chunks (auth plumbing, API services, page integrations).
